artworks.title: Noble Woman with a Small Hat
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 15 × 10 cm (5 7/8 × 3 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a standing position with arms crossed in front of the waist. The individual has detailed facial features and elegant hair styled in an elaborate headdress. They are wearing a richly detailed dress with puffed sleeves, lace detailing, and a voluminous skirt. A beaded necklace hangs from their neck. The background depicts a bustling street scene with buildings, and figures engaged in various activities.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for Callot's "The Penitents"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7 × 4.5 cm (2 3/4 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative plaque. It features a central inscription enclosed within an ornate frame. On top of the frame, there is a figure with a hooded appearance gazing downward. Flaming torches are on each side of the frame. Below the inscription, a bundle of tools is tied together with cord, resting on a platform. The edges of the plaque are adorned with decorative scrolls, foliage, and classical pillars. The text reads "LES PENITENTS ET PENITENTES PAR IACQUES CALLOT." Fine hatching and crosshatching details are used throughout the artwork.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with a seated figure under a tree. The figure is nestled against a large tree, engrossed in writing or reading a book that rests on their lap. The tree under which the figure sits has a twisted and gnarled trunk, with sprawling branches that extend across the top of the scene, laden with dense foliage. To the right of the figure, the landscape opens up, revealing distant hills and additional trees that contribute to the setting. The scene is detailed with fine cross-hatching and intricate linework.

artworks.title: Saint Mary Magdalene
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their hands clasped in front of their chest. They have long hair covered by a headscarf, wearing a flowing garment and standing on rocky terrain. The background features trees, foliage, and a distant town or village, with a sky above.

artworks.title: Death of the Magdalene
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclined on a chair inside a cave. The person is lying on their back with knees slightly bent and head tilted upwards. They have long hair, wear a draped garment, and have a halo above their head. A vessel or urn is nearby on a stone surface. Light enters through an opening in the cave.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure in a natural landscape. The central focus is a figure standing in a setting with a rocky background and trees on either side. The ground is uneven with a skull nearby. Around the figure are trees with detailed foliage, and a sense of depth is created by the depiction of a distant hill or rock formation. The drawing is highly detailed, with intricate lines used to convey texture and depth within the natural elements.

artworks.title: Saint Francis
artworks.description: The image depicts a lone figure standing in nature. The view shows a rocky landscape with a large, expressive tree in the center. The etching technique features intricate line work with varying thickness, adding depth and texture to the tree leaves and figure's robe. The color palette is monochromatic, using black ink on cream paper. The ground texture is created with crosshatching, and the tree roots are heavily detailed. The figure is shown with outstretched arms, looking upward. The distant landscape is shown with lighter etching, suggesting a continuation of the natural setting.

artworks.title: The Marriage at Cana
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered around a table. The scene depicts a circular table with a detailed cloth draped over it, set with dishes. Surrounding the table are several figures in period attire, featuring intricate line work suggestive of elaborate clothing. These figures are arranged in a semi-circle. One figure seated at the center seems to be illuminated by radiating lines. The scene is delicately sketched with fine lines that capture the intricate details of the figures and setting.

artworks.title: The Feast of the Pharisees
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered around a large table. The drawing shows several figures seated around an oval table filled with plates, cups, and a central platter. The characters in the drawing are depicted in robes, with two of them having halos. One figure is highlighted with radiating lines from the head. The style is characterized by fine lines and shading. The signature "Callot" is visible.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people sitting around a table. The central figure is facing the viewer, surrounded by others engaged in conversation or listening. The central figure has long hair and a beard, with defined facial features. They are illuminated with radiating lines from behind, creating a halo-like effect. The group is dressed in robes, and the table in front of them is small and round, with plates and chalices scattered on its surface. The setting is sparse, with no detailed background, just a simple, textured surface.

artworks.title: The Supper at Emmaus
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals seated around a circular table. The person in the center has long hair and a halo above their head. This individual is dressed in a robe and gesturing with their hand. The two other people wear robe-like clothing, with one having a balding head and the other wearing a turban. On the table, there are plates and a loaf of bread. The background is plain, and there is a signature at the bottom left of the print. The style indicates an older illustration technique, such as an etching or engraving.

artworks.title: The Garden
artworks.artist: Jacques Callot or Follower of Jacques Callot
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 8.6 × 22 cm (3 3/8 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a countryside scene with a rustic structure, trees, bushes, and figures engaged in activities. The background features a horizon with trees fading into the distance, creating a sense of vast space. The overall palette is monochromatic, with intricate line work typical of etching.

artworks.title: The Dovecot
artworks.artist: Jacques Callot or Follower of Jacques Callot
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 8.5 × 22 cm (3 3/8 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a horizon line and distant hills meeting the sky. Trees, small buildings, and a round barn or windmill are nestled on the horizon. In the foreground, there is a figure with a staff, a dog lying on a path, and a dense tree with intricate foliage on the left. The artwork features detailed linework with cross-hatched shading providing texture to the landscape and the clouds in the sky. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and grey, creating a calm visual effect.

artworks.title: The Watermill
artworks.artist: Jacques Callot or Follower of Jacques Callot
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 9 × 22.2 cm (3 9/16 × 8 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a low perspective of a river or canal. A nude figure is reaching towards the water on the left, while structures with arches and stairs are visible further along. The horizon, marked by trees and distant structures, is about a third up from the bottom, creating depth. Faint outlines of hills and buildings fill the background, blending into the sky. The style resembles a detailed etching, with controlled strokes for texture. The color palette is monochrome, with black lines contrasting the off-white paper.

artworks.title: The Small Port
artworks.artist: Jacques Callot or Follower of Jacques Callot
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 8.3 × 22 cm (3 1/4 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime scene with a bustling harbor. Various boats with tall masts and sails are on the water, while in the background, a cityscape with buildings and ships defines the horizon against a cloudy sky. Detailed lines and cross-hatching create texture and depth in the monochrome composition. People are depicted engaging in activities near rustic stone buildings on the right side.

artworks.title: The Review
artworks.description: The image shows a battlefield scene with soldiers and mounted troops in an organized military formation. Rows of soldiers and cavalry are depicted, observing a scene possibly involving training or preparation for battle. Various groups of troops are arranged in rectangular formations, and there are numerous figures on horseback, presumably officers or commanders overseeing the troops. In the foreground, there is an equestrian figure observing the scene, indicating a hierarchy or leadership presence on the battlefield. The drawing features meticulous line work and detailed portrayal of figures, suggesting a historical or documentative approach to capturing military maneuvers or parades.

artworks.title: Saint John Preaching in the Desert
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in a naturalistic setting. The scene shows various individuals positioned among boulders and trees, all facing a central figure standing or speaking on a raised platform. Surrounding this central point are clusters of people observing from different angles. Some are seated while others stand closely together. In the foreground, seated figures are absorbed in the scene. The setting includes trees and rock formations, giving a sense of enclosure and intimacy. The style features detailed linework, highlighting the forms of the entities and surroundings, creating an atmosphere of engagement and communal focus.

artworks.title: Saint Amond
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.1 × 28.2 cm (8 11/16 × 11 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is high, obscured by trees. A structure resembling a church and figures are visible in the distance. The meticulous etching creates textures and details in the foliage, clothing of figures, and landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily sepia tones. In the foreground, figures in historical clothing gather around a central figure resembling a priest or monk. Beyond them, trees canopy the scene, leading to distant buildings and figures.

artworks.title: The Punishments
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.3 × 22.6 cm (4 13/16 × 8 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a town square filled with a crowd gathered for a public event. Buildings and a tower are visible in the background, alongside a sky with clouds and flying birds. The scene includes a platform, gallows-like structures, a horse-drawn wagon, and diverse figures in different poses and clothing. The artwork is monochromatic, created using ink and white with detailed etching techniques to depict the busy gathering and architectural elements. Text within the image hints at the event depicted.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Saint Anthony [first version]
artworks.medium: etching [from a cut and damaged plate] on two sheets of laid paper pasted together
artworks.description: The image contains chaotic and intertwining lines and shapes forming an abstract composition. The elements include figures on horseback, winged creatures, and beings in dramatic poses. The arrangement suggests a scene of epic struggle.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for the Sacred Cosmologia (Title with Astrologers)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an astrolabe in a landscape. In the center is a large astrolabe on a pedestal, surrounded by figures engaged in study. The setting includes trees on the sides, with hills and structures in the background. In the foreground, there is a patch of earth bordered by a pond with small animals grazing. The drawing is detailed, with attention to textures and the quiet atmosphere of the landscape.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for the Sacred Cosmologia (Title with Astrologers)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 13.7 × 9.2 cm (5 3/8 × 3 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image showcases an engraving of a scene blending nature and human activity. In the foreground, figures are engaged in scholarly activities around an armillary sphere and texts. Some figures hold boards with diagrams, while others are focused on tasks. The background features trees, hills, and a pastoral scene with people and animals. The engraving style includes intricate line work and hatching, typical of black and white etching techniques. The color palette is monotone in varying shades of gray. High branches with birds are included in the composition.

artworks.title: The Cult of God
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7 × 5.4 cm (2 3/4 × 2 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with grand architecture reminiscent of a cathedral or church. It features large columns, arches, an altar with religious symbols and an open book, and statues. The intricate details in the architecture create a classic and Baroque aesthetic.

artworks.title: The Cult of the Demon
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.7 × 5 cm (2 5/8 × 1 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large goat sitting on a rock formation in a cave-like setting. The focus is on the goat, which has long and curved horns, positioned on a rocky pedestal. Several figures are engaged in various activities around the goat. The scene conveys a mysterious atmosphere, with swirling lines suggesting motion and energy coming from the fire or altar. The composition's precise linework and dynamic arrangement of elements create a sense of movement and reverence towards the goat.
